results.title: Pakistan’s Tarbela-5 hydropower project hit by fresh collapse; Workers evacuated, construction halted - Babushahi.com
results.snippet:
The incident occurred at the 1,530-megawatt Tarbela Dam 5th Extension Hydropower Project, where civil construction work has been awarded to China’s Power Construction Corporation of China Limited (PCCCL).

The latest collapse is the second major structural failure reported at the project since 2025. It has renewed concerns over construction standards, contractual compliance and project management.
